_comment: Paste ONLY the mcpServers block below into Cline > MCP Servers > Configure (cline_mcp_settings.json) — Cline ignores this documentation key. Option A (npx, the ACTIVE entry below) works for every user right now: no Docker, no login — pinned to the latest npm release of marketnow-mcp (scripts/check-version-sync.mjs validates the pin against the live npm registry). Option B (Docker, in _alternative_docker) runs the repo-exact audited image CI builds from this repository — it requires the GHCR package to be public (org owners: one click at https://github.com/orgs/alicelabs-llc/packages/container/marketnow-mcp/settings → Danger Zone → Change visibility → Public) or `docker login ghcr.io` with a read:packages PAT (see integrations/cline/README.md). Use ONE, not both.

_alternative_docker.note: Repo-exact audited build (mcp-server/package.json version; CI-built, handshake-tested). Needs the GHCR package public or docker login. Swap this into the marketnow entry below to use it.
